reauthentification_requise.title: Auto Backup: destination “{nom}” must be re-authorised
reauthentification_requise.description:
Provider “{fournisseur}” refused to renew access for destination “{nom}”: the authorisation expired or was revoked. Other destinations keep working.

To restore it, open the Auto Backup integration options, choose “Re-authorise a destination” and select “{nom}”.

ajouter_destination.title: Add a destination
ajouter_destination.description: Choose where a copy of your backups should be sent.

identifiants.title: Your application credentials
identifiants.description:
Create an application with “{fournisseur}”, then declare this redirect URL in it:

`{url_de_retour}`

Then enter that application's client ID and secret below. They stay in your Home Assistant instance and are never logged.

autorisation.title: Authorisation
autorisation.description: Authorise Auto Backup in the window that just opened, then come back here.

destination.title: New destination
destination.description: Provider “{fournisseur}”. Name this destination, choose the remote folder backups are uploaded to and, optionally, a retention of its own.

reautoriser_destination.title: Re-authorise a destination
reautoriser_destination.description: Choose the destination whose access must be renewed. Other destinations are left untouched.

supprimer_destination.title: Remove a destination
supprimer_destination.description: The configuration and authorisation of the chosen destinations will be erased. Backups already uploaded to the provider are not deleted.

reglages_notifications.title: Notification settings
reglages_notifications.description:
When a backup definitively fails to reach a remote destination, Auto Backup can show a persistent notification naming the destination, the backup and the cause. A destination never has more than one such notification: it is updated on each new failure and disappears as soon as an upload succeeds.

Turned off, notifications are no longer created: the “auto_backup.upload_failed” event, the error log and the repair issue reporting a destination to re-authorise are all kept.

data.notify_on_failure: Notify upload failures and access to renew

reglages_televersement.title: Upload settings
reglages_televersement.description: Maximum time allowed to send a backup to a remote destination. Past that, the upload is aborted and reported through the “auto_backup.upload_failed” event; the local backup itself is left untouched. Allow plenty of time for a large backup or a slow connection.
